title: Unit Event — Happy Enjoy Music! — Episode5 Full-Power Fun!

meta.Event Outline: With their new song released, Leo/need looks forward to Jam Fest. Saki, nervous before her first festival, encounters a familiar face...

rows.Line: Rookie Stage

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Here we go.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: anemone's music always hits me really hard...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah...
As much as I envy them, I really like this song.

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Hey, who's playing this song?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Oh, it's anemone.
They sound amazing live...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (More and more people are starting to gather. There was like no one here a second ago.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Saku and the others have definitely gotten everyone's attention.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (That's so cool...)

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: You guys can do better than that!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: That's what I like to hear!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Iori and them really know how to get a crowd going.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They're totally bouncing off the walls!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
Saku raised the temperature by putting on an incredible singing performance for them, and STANDOUT's energy is sending them sky high.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Not only that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This song... The way she's singing is so powerful...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This is what a professional band is supposed to sound like live.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Which means we gotta do the same.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right...!
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're on deck.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's do our best, everyone...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Are you nervous, Ichi?
Your lips are pursed.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: S-Sorry. This is our first big festival, and we have to follow some really amazing performances...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If someone asked me right now whether or not we'll be able to do what they just did...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I get how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Me too.
My hands are actually shaking a little.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
But I wouldn't worry too much.
Let's just go out there and do our best.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We practiced as much as we could in preparation for today, so I'm certain that we have what it takes. So, I wouldn't worry too much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And I'm also certain that some people are here specifically to see us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, let's go out there and do our best.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: For all those who've come to see us. The whole audience out there. Everyone... Let's go show them what our music's about!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We gotta go out there and move their hearts.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Right!
We're at a big festival, so let's go have some fun!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Which band's next?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
It says it's Leo/need.
Do you know what they're like?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Oh, I think that's that one band? Didn't the VIRTUAL SINGER version of one of their songs go really viral recently?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Oh, for that cider commercial?
This'll be my first time actually listening to them play.

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Show us what you got, Leo/need...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
We're Leo/need.
We promise to play with everything we have today, so get ready for...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Blue Moments!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness...!
It's not a lot, but a few people out there are really listening!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(They're so far from the stage...
I can't really tell if they're having fun.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Then, that means we just have to produce more energy!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (So that our song excites them even more.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Saki...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Wow... Way to go, Saki.
In that case, I'll...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(They all found that extra gear...!
I need to do my best to keep up.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Maintain this energy! Until the end!)

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: They look like they're having so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Yeah, plus...

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Oh, I know this song!
It's the one from that commercial!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
It sounds totally different live...
Wanna stop and watch?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: (Most of the attendees were headed towards the other stages...)

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: (But now, this song is starting to attract more and more people.)

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Great show, girls...
